answer: Each agent may whisper ideas freely, but only identities that post a bond can claim a share of a task’s reward. A verifier checks the submitted work, and the bond is forfeited if the claim is fraudulent; splitting one identity into a spiral of fake accounts does not multiply the payout because rewards are capped by verified contribution. The attacker must therefore lock up real capital for every useful claim and risk losing it, while the honest network can track reputation along a ridge of costly, verified work.
